prima_materia_raw: Snow covers graves until inscriptions disappear.
vectors_raw: The snow can be read as a medium of remembrance.
psych_pathology_raw: Fear of being forgotten attaches itself to winter burial.
atmospherics_raw: Muted wind, white fields, stone edges under snow.

scene_hooks.hook_text_raw: Lore Architect could build an entry in which a remote field might be consecrated for failed initiates, with snow allowed to obscure their epitaphs.

seed_lines.seed_line: At first light she danced for heaven; by nightfall the snow was rehearsing her absence.
